Plan_of_Care.content: Encouraged to maintain hydration with fluids
May use oral rehydration solution such as Dioralyte over the counter
Advised to eat soft foods such as crackers, toast, and jam initially
Advised to avoid dairy, fish, meat, and eggs initially
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Diet: soft foods (crackers, toast, jam); avoid dairy, fish, meat, eggs initially

Plan_of_Care.content: Yogurt is allowed as a probiotic
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Diet: soft foods (crackers, toast, jam); avoid dairy, fish, meat, eggs initially; yogurt OK (probiotic).

Plan_of_Care.content: Plan to advance diet to boiled or mashed vegetables
Plan to reintroduce meat, egg, and fish after 48 hours without diarrhea
Plan_of_Care.source_text: then reintroduce meat/egg/fish after 48h without diarrhea

Plan_of_Care.content: If stool frequency exceeds 6–8 times per day or signs of dehydration occur, patient should contact clinic or consider hospital evaluation
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Red flags: if stools >6–8/day or signs of dehydration → contact clinic/consider hospital

Plan_of_Care.content: If diarrhea persists longer than one week or any blood appears in stool, patient should submit a stool sample and may need antibiotics
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • If persists >1 week or any blood in stool → submit stool sample; may need abx
